name: Lily Pad
author: idv7lol contributors
description: A night pond on the whole cluster: a tree frog hops on its lily pad in the middle of the rev ring, faster the faster the car goes, fireflies light up as the revs climb, the speed is a needle on a lily pad, and fuel, oil and water stand as reeds. Ripples, a turning swirl, a gear that flashes on each change, and a frog that croaks near the redline. Swap the frog for your own animation in the Studio.
